title: "Learning path"
description: >-
  The lessons of the site by course and by method, with their difficulty and

---

The lessons are organised by course: a course is a physics subject, and
every lesson belongs to one. Methods cut across courses: simulation, LLM
agents, agent-based modelling, and formal proofs in Lean. Each lesson names
the lessons it builds on and what it assumes you know from elsewhere, and
says what you will be able to do after it. Read a course from its first
lesson, follow one method across courses, or start with any lesson whose
prerequisites you have.

This page is generated from the lessons when the site is built. A course or
a method appears once it has a lesson.

#| echo: false
#| output: asis

print(learning_path())
